reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "ACME Certificate Profiles: cert-manager now supports the selection of ACME certificate profiles, allowing users to request different categories of certificates…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional capability to select ACME certificate profiles; the evidence states no operational impact for existing setups.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds support for selecting ACME certificate profiles (e.g. tlsserver, shortlived) when requesting certificates from an ACME CA.
